none: PAS BH-E14778: Roman coin: nummus of the House of Constantine (incomplete)
contea di ritrovamento: Hertfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine*, dating to the period AD 321 - 324 (Reece period 16). CAESARVM NOSTRORVM reverse depicting a wreath containing the legend 'VOT/X'. Uncertain mint. Diameter: 18.5mm; thickness: 1mm; weight: 0.75g
